item.title: Comment on Higher-dose Wegovy could increase patient expectation, warns PDA by Hannah Krol
item.description: In reply to <a href="https://pharmaceutical-journal.com/article/news/higher-dose-wegovy-could-increase-patient-expectation-warns-pda#comment-185335">Ghamshyambhai Patidar</a>. Thank you so much for your comment, Ghamshyambhai. This has now been amended. Many thanks for getting in touch, Hannah Krol Deputy Chief Subeditor, The Pharmaceutical Journal

item.title: Comment on Prescribing pathfinders: what’s stopping community pharmacy delivering care for long-term conditions? by Sidney Burford
item.description: One reason why pharmacists may not be able to deliver satisfactory long-term health care is that the patients themselves and their medical conditions change over time, and these changes need to be recognized and monitored. item.title: Comment on UKPPLAB sets out proposals for wider royal college membership by Howard McNulty
item.description: The PJ has provided little news of the Royal College progress since last years vote. I see on social media some people are campaigning for votes for new organisations. An explanation in your columns of what is going on might help retain or grow membership numbers.

item.title: Comment on Sarah Cockbill (1947–2026) by Michael Beaman
item.description: Sarah was also a valued member of the Retired Pharmacists Group and represented Wales on our national steering committee. She will be greatly missed.

item.title: Comment on Sarah Cockbill (1947–2026) by David Reissner
item.description: I am sorry to learn of Sarah's passing. I knew her as a knowledgeable contributor to the 11th and 12th editions of Dale & Appelbe's Pharmacy and Medicines Law.
